description: The only public start path for project-class managed work. The server derives the spawning coordinator instance/session from authenticated call context and verifies that session holds spawned_by_role; caller-supplied actor or spawner-instance fields never authorize. It validates and immutably binds the exact brief path/SHA-256, completion-contract schema, lane, role, work/budget class, model, effort, runtime, host/allowed_hosts, visibility, local_name, report/TTL windows, tool/permission/transport policy, coordinator lineage, and future uptake/report/watchdog/TTL deadlines. It writes managed_dispatch(state='preparing') before any host side effect, creates the linked managed_session attempt, dispatches through the runtime-specific host adapter, and persists first-turn source/delivered/error evidence on both records. A confirmed host submission returns uptake_pending; a failed or unsupported first-turn submission returns uptake_uncertain with the exact error. Neither is active: only a later structured worker ACK can make the dispatch active. A host start failure returns failed data containing the durable dispatch_id, failed_start state, causal version, and next action so recovery remains addressable. Raw public spawn_session hard-refuses project work; retries reconstruct the replacement only from the immutable prepared dispatch.
embedding_description: Start a bounded worker lane through one durable contract written before spawn, with exact brief hash, completion evidence contract, runtime/host policy, and all supervision deadlines. Returns a linked attempt and transport evidence but never claims the worker has taken up the brief until its structured ACK arrives.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: dispatch (the durable managed_dispatch projection, including dispatch_id, causal version, state, deadlines, expected completion contract, current attempt, first-turn evidence, and next action) plus attempt (the linked managed_session spawn result).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with dispatch_id, state, current attempt identity, first_turn_delivered/error, next_required_action, and responsible_role. Say uptake_pending means submission confirmed but ACK absent, and uptake_uncertain means the submission outcome needs a coordinator decision. Never call either state active or complete.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Validates the complete contract, inserts managed_dispatch before spawning, then invokes the ordinary lifecycle spawn only with the newly issued dispatch_id. State access uses StateManagementInterface and every authoritative transition is causal-versioned.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Required-field, completion-contract-schema, authority, and deadline errors mean no host was spawned. brief_missing/brief_hash_mismatch means the exact brief evidence failed. dispatch_host_not_allowed means the requested host was outside the prepared policy. managed_dispatch_required is the companion raw-spawn refusal. Host/runtime start errors return failed result data with dispatch_id/state/version/next_required_action and leave a durable supervised failed_start row; first-turn submission failures leave uptake_uncertain.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct validation inputs and issue a new dispatch only when no row was created. For a returned failed_start or uptake_uncertain row, read managed_dispatch_status and use resolve_managed_dispatch with a fresh causal decision; never blind-spawn a second worker.
